## Summary

- describe the user-visible change
- explain the technical scope

## Validation

- [ ] `pytest -q`
- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] docs updated if public behavior changed

## Release Notes

Release history lives in git tags / GitHub Releases — there is no
hand-written `CHANGELOG.md`.

- [ ] no release note needed
- [ ] user-facing highlight — add it to `docs/release-notes.md`
